reasons: Cited §8.2 matches the preferred position: 12-month (not multi-year) automatic renewals, 30-day Customer opt-out notice, and a Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal (plus a deadline extension if the reminder is missed, which favours us).
§8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and 3%, equal to the preferred cap, with 90 days' notice and no uplift on prepaid periods.
Deterministic check confirms notice window of 30 days, within the preferred ≤30-day threshold.
Compliant status is correctly claimed: no redline or comment was proposed, and none is warranted; rationale accurately describes the clause.
